description: In follower_store.rs add(), the ON CONFLICT clause updates inbox_url but not followed_at. If a follower changes their inbox URL and re-sends a Follow, the followed_at timestamp stays at the original follow time, not the re-follow time. This is a minor semantic issue but it means the followed_at column cannot be used to detect re-follows or to implement TTL-based eviction correctly.
title: follower_store ON CONFLICT does not update followed_at timestamp
